environment.notes: BRANCHLAB V0.3. Each step is a fresh process (local) or a fresh Archil microVM (default image, python3 -S). No host crash or lost-AZ test. Local and Archil have different hardware. handoff/sqlite/readfan/writers test FRESH-EXECUTION visibility, not a long-lived client's caches; the visibility case tests those with one long-lived reader exec. Archil commits a writing exec at exit, so a fresh-VM read after write-fsync cannot separate fsync durability from that exit commit. Independent writers never share a file. SQLite in sqlite/* uses journal_mode=TRUNCATE; semantics/* records what an exec can do to entries another exec created, with and without `archil checkout`. Cleanup runs with a conditional mount via POST /api/exec. No branches/checkpoints are created.
